caption: A saucepan is tipped and soup poured into a bowl until it is full and begins to spill over the sides.

sa.check: A saucepan is tipped over a bowl.
The pour comes first, then the fill, then the spill.

pc.expect: The level rises steadily while pouring.
pc.fail: The level drops while pouring; or it jumps; or the bowl is full before the pour.

pc.expect: The overflow begins exactly when the soup reaches the rim and runs down the outside onto the counter.
pc.fail: It overflows before reaching the rim; or the bowl is over-full with a domed surface and nothing spills; or the outside stays dry.

pc.expect: The stream falls straight down and the overflow runs down.
pc.fail: The stream curves up; or the overflow climbs; or soup hangs in the air.

pc.expect: The soup is a liquid: it splashes and settles flat.
pc.fail: It pours as a rigid rod; or as a solid lump; or as beads.

pc.expect: One saucepan and one bowl, and soup comes only from the pan.
pc.fail: Soup appears in the bowl with no stream; or the bowl duplicates; or soup passes through the bowl.

pc.expect: The soup's colour, the bowl and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The soup changes colour; or the bowl changes shape; or the counter rearranges.
